title: How OpenAI o3 reasoning model changes software development forever

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if coding became as easy as thinking?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: OpenAI’s o3 model is changing how developers write code.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s a reasoning model that writes code from natural language.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It can generate full apps with just a simple prompt.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects every developer, especially non-coders.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The future of software development is here, faster than you think.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Ready to see how your ideas become code in seconds?
